title: Hoist insert_if_allowed closure outside event loop
description:
What: Move the insert_if_allowed closure definition from inside the main event loop to outside it in kithd/src/events.rs.

Why: The closure is redefined on every loop iteration even though it is identical each time. It only captures type_filter: Option<TypeFilter> which is Copy (u8-sized), so hoisting it is trivially safe.

Algorithm:
1. In events.rs, find the main tokio task loop (around line 260).
2. The closure is currently defined at lines 274-282 (inside the loop):
     let insert_if_allowed = |batch: &mut HashMap<String, String>, type_name: String, new_state: String| { ... };
3. Move this definition to just BEFORE the loop, after type_filter is in scope (it is set up before the loop starts).
4. The closure captures type_filter by copy; no lifetime issues.
5. The two call sites (lines 284 and 294) remain unchanged.
6. Run cargo fmt, cargo clippy, cargo test -p kithd to verify.

Defensive rules:
- Do not change the closure body — only move it.
- Verify the borrow checker accepts the move (type_filter must be in scope before the loop).
- cargo clippy --all-features must produce zero warnings.

Closes: KITH-kg2
